question: In what locus does dissolution occur for the entity in question, and what is the full set of things to be told about that dissolution?
premises: An inquiry is made as to the locus in which dissolution is entered.
It is stated that all of that is to be told.
The request is directed to another to tell it to the speaker.
inference: The speaker requests to be told in what locus dissolution occurs and the full account of that matter.
uncertainties: Referent of tat+sarvaṃ not specified within the verse
plain_english: And indeed, in what does it go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
